kamloops.title: B.C. family rescues exhausted baby bear swimming in Okanagan Lake
kamloops.description: Christina Zamniuk says they were boating between their Vernon lakehouse and Adventure Bay last weekend when a baby bear was spotted swimming in the middle of the lake.

kamloops.title: Penticton, B.C., city councillor found guilty of historic sexual offences involving a child
kamloops.description: A Penticton, B.C., city councillor has been found guilty of four counts of sexual interference and one count of invitation to sexual touching. The charges stem from his time as a youth basketball coach in Sarnia, Ont.

prince-george.title: Dawson Creek residents say municipal animal control services a ballot box issue
prince-george.description: In May, city council voted to end its contract with the SPCA, saying it would save taxpayers roughly $300,000. The contact expires on Dec. 1 and will not be replaced.

southeast.title: Former BC Conservative director accused of hiring private investigator
southeast.description: Aisha Estey, who was the president of the BC Conservative Party for about three years told Global News that she found out on Wednesday night.

all.title: Northern B.C. officials demand province honour commitment to build helipad in Prince George
all.description: Elected officials in northern B.C. say they want to see a helipad included in the official business plan for a new acute care tower in Prince George before construction starts in 2027.
